name: COG ANBL0531: Carboplatin + Etoposide + Cyclophosphamide + Doxorubicin (Intermediate-Risk Neuroblastoma)

source.textbook: Principles and Practice of Pediatric Oncology, 8th ed.

institution.provenance: COG ANBL0531 Phase III Study for Intermediate-Risk Neuroblastoma (Twist et al. J Clin Oncol 2019)

premedications.name: Mesna
premedications.dose: 200 mg/m2 IV at hr 0, 4, 8 of cyclophosphamide

supportiveCare: Pre- and post-hydration with D5 0.45% NS + 20 mEq KCl/L at 125-150 mL/m2/hr
Filgrastim (G-CSF) 5 mcg/kg/day SC starting 24-48 hours after chemotherapy until ANC > 1500/mcL post-nadir
Audiometry baseline and post-cycle 2 and 4 to monitor carboplatin ototoxicity
monitoring: CBC with differential twice weekly during nadir
Comprehensive metabolic panel (BUN, creatinine, electrolytes, LFTs) prior to each cycle
Echocardiogram (LVEF / shortening fraction) baseline and after 150 mg/m2 cumulative doxorubicin
Urine HVA/VMA and tumor imaging (CT/MRI + MIBG) every 2 cycles
clearanceChecks: Serum creatinine normal for age or GFR >= 70 mL/min/1.73m2

doseModificationRules.text: Reduce carboplatin dose by 25% or substitute with alternate non-ototoxic agent per pediatric oncology tumor board.

doseModificationRules.condition: Prolonged myelosuppression (>28 days to recover counts)
doseModificationRules.text: Reduce etoposide and carboplatin doses by 20% for subsequent cycles.

drugs.name: Carboplatin
drugs.notes: Carboplatin 560 mg/m2 IV in D5W or NS over 1 hour on Day 1. In infants <12 kg or <12 months, dose per weight at 18.7 mg/kg.

drugs.name: Etoposide
drugs.notes: Etoposide 120 mg/m2/day IV over 2 hours on Days 1-3. In infants <12 kg, dose per weight at 4 mg/kg/day.

drugs.name: Cyclophosphamide
drugs.notes: Cyclophosphamide 1000 mg/m2 IV over 1 hour on Day 1 with Mesna uroprotection. In infants <12 kg, dose per weight at 33.3 mg/kg.

drugs.name: DOXOrubicin
drugs.notes: DOXOrubicin 30 mg/m2 IV push or short infusion on Day 1. Lifetime pediatric cumulative anthracycline cap applied (warn 250 mg/m2, hard 350 mg/m2). In infants <12 kg, dose per weight at 1 mg/kg.
